title: Pick a supported Codex app-server release for workers
body:
worker start exits 65 "unsupported Codex app-server version": resolveCodexExecutable (src/hosts/codex.ts:79) picks the newest ~/.codex/packages/app-server-daemon release (0.167.0) while spec/worker-scope.json supportedVersions is [0.166.0].
Workaround used in t-ga6ht93: KRN_CODEX_BIN=~/.codex/packages/app-server-daemon/releases/0.166.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/bin/codex.
Fix: prefer the newest release whose version is in supportedVersions, or add 0.167.0 after a live worker check.
